'''Coruscant Air Traffic Control''', alternatively referred to as '''Galactic City Air Traffic Control''' or '''Coruscant Traffic Control''', was the [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] traffic authority that maintained the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]

==History==
Coruscant Air Traffic Control was charged with monitoring the skylane traffic in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It maintained information on all speeders and their level of permissions on various skylane routes. It also retained hangar and maintenance information.<ref name="Wedgesgamble" />

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], data on Coruscant maintained by Traffic Control was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when they [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured Coruscant]].<ref name="Wedgesgamble" />
